title: Anomaly Detection
description: Anomaly detection: Normal davranıştan sapan outlier'ları tespit etme. Isolation Forest, One-Class SVM, LOF, Autoencoders. Fraud detection, network security, predictive maintenance.

content.level0_basic: Anomaly Detection (Anormallik Tespiti), normal davranıştan sapan nadir örnekleri (outlier, anomaly) bulma işlemidir. Örnek: Kredi kartı fraud (normal: küçük alışveriş, anomaly: 10K$ harcama), network security (normal trafik vs DDoS attack), predictive maintenance (makine normal çalışır, anomaly: arıza belirtisi). Çoğunlukla unsupervised: Sadece normal data var, anomaly'ler nadirdir (%0.1-5). Anomaly = normal distribution'dan çok uzak.
content.level1_beginner: Anomaly detection yaklaşımları: (1) **Statistical**: Z-score, Gaussian distribution (|z|>3 → anomaly). (2) **Distance-based**: KNN, LOF (Local Outlier Factor) - komşulardan çok uzak → anomaly. (3) **Isolation-based**: Isolation Forest - anomaly'leri izole etmek kolay (az split). (4) **Density-based**: DBSCAN - düşük density bölgesi. (5) **One-Class SVM**: Normal data boundary öğren, dışarısı anomaly. (6) **Deep learning**: Autoencoder - normal data'yı reconstruct et, anomaly → yüksek reconstruction error. Metrikler: Precision, Recall, F1 (imbalanced), ROC-AUC.
content.level2_application: Pratik uygulamalar: (1) **Fraud Detection**: Kredi kartı, sigorta, e-ticaret. Isolation Forest, LSTM (sequential patterns). (2) **Network Security**: Intrusion detection, DDoS, malware. One-Class SVM, deep learning. (3) **Predictive Maintenance**: Sensör data, makine arızası. Time series anomaly, LSTM autoencoder. (4) **Healthcare**: EKG, MRI anomaly, hasta monitoring. CNN autoencoder (image), LSTM (time series). (5) **Quality Control**: Üretim hatası tespiti, görsel inspection. Computer vision + anomaly detection. (6) **IoT**: Sensör data anomaly, smart city. Streaming anomaly detection (online learning). Framework'ler: PyOD (Python Outlier Detection), Alibi Detect, scikit-learn.
content.level3_advanced: İleri seviye: (1) **Time Series Anomaly**: STL decomposition, ARIMA residuals, LSTM autoencoder, Prophet anomaly detection. Contextual anomaly (seasonal). (2) **Deep Learning**: VAE (Variational Autoencoder) - probabilistic, GAN (Generative Adversarial Network) - generator learns normal. (3) **Ensemble**: Isolation Forest + LOF + Autoencoder → voting, stacking. (4) **Semi-supervised**: Labeled anomalies varsa (rare), PU learning (Positive-Unlabeled). (5) **Online Learning**: Streaming data, concept drift. Incremental learning, sliding window. (6) **Explainability**: Hangi feature anomaly'yi tetikledi? SHAP, attention weights. (7) **Contextual**: Aynı değer normal olabilir (context'e göre): Yaz 30°C normal, kış 30°C anomaly.
content.level4_expert: Expert seviyede, production systems, real-time detection ve research frontiers önemlidir. (1) **Production**: Model serving (ONNX, TorchScript), streaming (Kafka, Flink), alert system, dashboard (Grafana). (2) **Threshold Tuning**: False positive vs false negative trade-off. Dynamic threshold (adaptive), percentile-based. (3) **Imbalanced Data**: Anomaly %0.1 → extreme imbalance. Focal loss, cost-sensitive learning, anomaly generation (SMOTE for anomalies). (4) **Multi-modal Anomaly**: Birden fazla data source (log + metrics + image). Multi-modal fusion, late/early fusion. (5) **Graph Anomaly**: Social network fraud, knowledge graph. GNN-based anomaly detection. (6) **Causal Anomaly**: Correlation vs causation. Root cause analysis. (7) **Federated Anomaly**: Privacy-preserving (healthcare, finance). Federated learning. Research: **Self-supervised anomaly** (contrastive learning), **Zero-shot** (no normal training data), **Adversarial robustness** (adversarial anomalies).

whatIsIt: Anomaly Detection, normal pattern'den önemli ölçüde sapan rare instance'ları tespit etme. Matematiksel: P(x) << threshold → anomaly. Statistical: Gaussian, z-score (|z|>3). Distance: k-NN distance >> normal. Isolation: Isolation Forest, az split ile izole edilir. Reconstruction: Autoencoder, reconstruction error >> threshold. Unsupervised: Sadece normal data (anomaly çok nadir). Semi-supervised: Az anomaly label varsa. Supervised: Yeterli anomaly label (classification).
whyNeeded: Anomaly detection kritik çünkü: (1) **Fraud Prevention**: Yıllık $40B+ kayıp (credit card fraud). Early detection kritik. (2) **Cybersecurity**: DDoS, malware, intrusion detection. 0-day attacks. (3) **Predictive Maintenance**: Uçak motoru, fabrika, power grid. Downtime costly ($260K/hour). (4) **Healthcare**: Hasta kritik durum, arrhythmia detection. Hayat kurtarır. (5) **Rare Events**: Anomaly çok nadir (%0.1-5), supervised learning için yeterli label yok. (6) **Cost**: False negative çok costly (fraud $10K), false positive acceptable (manual review). (7) **Real-time**: Immediate action gerekli (network attack → block).
realWorldAnalogy: Anomaly detection'ı havaalanı güvenliğine benzetebiliriz. **Normal yolcular**: Çoğunluk, benzer davranış (check-in, güvenlik, boarding). **Anomaly**: Şüpheli davranış (çok fazla bagaj, nervous, metalik obje). **Detection methods**: (1) **Statistical** (Z-score): Ortalama yolcudan çok farklı (ağırlık 100kg bagaj, normal 20kg). (2) **Distance-based** (LOF): Diğer yolculardan çok farklı davranış (tek başına, izole). (3) **Isolation Forest**: Şüpheli olanı izole etmek kolay (bir soru: 'metal var mı?' → ayırır). (4) **Autoencoder**: Normal yolcu profilini öğren, bu profile uymayan → şüpheli. **Trade-off**: Çok strict → çok false positive (normal yolcu rahatsız), çok loose → false negative (tehlikeli kaçar). Balance kritik!

formulas: \text{Isolation Forest Score}: \quad s(x, n) = 2^{-\frac{E(h(x))}{c(n)}} \quad \text{(avg path length)}

stepByStep: 1. **Problem Definition**: Anomaly tipi: Point (single instance), contextual (time/location dependent), collective (sequence). Labeled data var mı? (unsupervised, semi-supervised, supervised).
2. **Data Collection**: Normal data topla (çoğunluk). Anomaly varsa label et (az sayıda). Time series ise temporal order önemli. Feature engineering: domain knowledge.
3. **EDA**: Normal data distribution'ı anla. Histogram, scatter plots. Correlation, seasonality (time series). Anomaly examples varsa visualize et.

4. **Method Selection**: (a) Unlabeled: Isolation Forest, LOF, One-Class SVM, Autoencoder. (b) Few labeled anomalies: Semi-supervised, PU learning. (c) Sufficient labels: Supervised classification (imbalanced handling).

5. **Training**: Unsupervised: Sadece normal data ile train et. Contamination parameter (expected anomaly ratio, örn: 0.01). Semi-supervised: Normal + az anomaly. Validation split (temporal for time series).
6. **Anomaly Scoring**: Her instance için anomaly score hesapla. Isolation Forest: path length. Autoencoder: reconstruction error. LOF: local density ratio. One-Class SVM: decision function.
7. **Threshold Selection**: Percentile-based (örn: 95th percentile → top 5% anomaly). ROC curve ile optimal threshold (if validation labels var). Domain expert input (acceptable false positive rate).
8. **Evaluation**: Labeled test set varsa: Precision, Recall, F1, ROC-AUC. Unlabeled: Visual inspection, domain expert review. Confusion matrix (false positive analysis).
9. **Post-processing**: Anomaly explanation: Hangi feature'lar anomaly'ye sebep? SHAP, feature contribution. Alert system: Threshold aşıldığında notify. Manual review workflow.
10. **Production Deployment**: Real-time scoring (streaming data), model monitoring (concept drift, performance degradation), threshold adaptation (dynamic), feedback loop (manual labels → retrain).
algorithm.complexity: **Zaman Karmaşıklığı**: Z-score: O(N), LOF: O(N²) naive (O(N log N) with indexing), Isolation Forest: O(T·N·log N) (T=trees), One-Class SVM: O(N²) to O(N³), Autoencoder: O(epochs·batch·model_params). **Inference**: Isolation Forest O(T·log N), Autoencoder O(forward pass), LOF O(k·log N) with index. **Uzay**: Statistical O(D), Distance-based O(N·D), Isolation Forest O(T·N), Autoencoder O(model_params). **Scalability**: Streaming: Online LOF, Incremental Isolation Forest, mini-batch autoencoder. Big data: Spark MLlib, Dask.

codeExamples.title: Z-score Anomaly Detection
codeExamples.code:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Sample data
np.random.seed(42)
normal_data = np.random.normal(50, 10, 1000)
anomalies = np.array([120, 130, -20, -10])  # Outliers
data = np.concatenate([normal_data, anomalies])

df = pd.DataFrame({'value': data})

# Z-score
z_scores = np.abs(stats.zscore(df['value']))
threshold = 3
df['z_score'] = z_scores
df['is_anomaly'] = z_scores > threshold

anomalies_detected = df[df['is_anomaly']]
print(f'Total: {len(df)}, Anomalies: {len(anomalies_detected)}')
print('\nDetected anomalies:')
print(anomalies_detected[['value', 'z_score']].sort_values('z_score', ascending=False).head())

# Visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 4))
plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)
plt.hist(df['value'], bins=50, alpha=0.7)
plt.axvline(df['value'].mean(), color='r', linestyle='--', label='Mean')
plt.axvline(df['value'].mean() + 3*df['value'].std(), color='orange', linestyle='--', label='+3σ')
plt.axvline(df['value'].mean() - 3*df['value'].std(), color='orange', linestyle='--', label='-3σ')
plt.legend()
plt.title('Distribution')

plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)
plt.scatter(range(len(df)), df['value'], c=df['is_anomaly'], cmap='coolwarm', alpha=0.6)
plt.title('Anomalies (red)')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
codeExamples.explanation: Z-score: En basit yöntem. |z|>3 → anomaly (Gaussian assumption). Univariate, hızlı, baseline.

codeExamples.title: Isolation Forest
codeExamples.code:
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import IsolationForest
from sklearn.datasets import make_blobs
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Generate data
X, _ = make_blobs(n_samples=300, centers=1, cluster_std=0.5, random_state=42)
X_outliers = np.random.uniform(low=-4, high=4, size=(20, 2))
X = np.vstack([X, X_outliers])

print(f'Total samples: {len(X)} (300 normal + 20 outliers)')

# Isolation Forest
clf = IsolationForest(
    contamination=0.1,  # Expected outlier ratio
    random_state=42,
    n_estimators=100
)

y_pred = clf.fit_predict(X)
anomalies = X[y_pred == -1]
normal = X[y_pred == 1]

print(f'\nDetected: {len(anomalies)} anomalies, {len(normal)} normal')

# Anomaly scores
scores = clf.decision_function(X)
print(f'Score range: [{scores.min():.3f}, {scores.max():.3f}]')
print('Lower score = more anomalous')

# Visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))

plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)
plt.scatter(normal[:, 0], normal[:, 1], c='blue', s=20, label='Normal')
plt.scatter(anomalies[:, 0], anomalies[:, 1], c='red', s=50, label='Anomaly', marker='x')
plt.legend()
plt.title('Isolation Forest Detection')

plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)
plt.scatter(X[:, 0], X[:, 1], c=scores, cmap='coolwarm', s=20)
plt.colorbar(label='Anomaly Score')
plt.title('Anomaly Scores (lower = more anomalous)')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
codeExamples.explanation: Isolation Forest: Anomaly'leri izole etmek kolay (az split). Tree ensemble, scalable, no distribution assumption.

codeExamples.title: LOF (Local Outlier Factor)
codeExamples.code:
import numpy as np
from sklearn.neighbors import LocalOutlierFactor
from sklearn.datasets import make_blobs
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Data with clusters
X1, _ = make_blobs(n_samples=200, centers=[[0, 0]], cluster_std=0.3, random_state=42)
X2, _ = make_blobs(n_samples=200, centers=[[3, 3]], cluster_std=0.3, random_state=42)
X = np.vstack([X1, X2])
X_outliers = np.array([[1.5, 1.5], [4, 0], [-1, 4]])  # Between clusters
X = np.vstack([X, X_outliers])

print(f'Total: {len(X)} samples')

# LOF
lof = LocalOutlierFactor(
    n_neighbors=20,
    contamination=0.05
)

y_pred = lof.fit_predict(X)
anomalies = X[y_pred == -1]
normal = X[y_pred == 1]

print(f'Detected: {len(anomalies)} anomalies')

# LOF scores (negative = outlier)
scores = lof.negative_outlier_factor_
print(f'\nLOF score range: [{scores.min():.2f}, {scores.max():.2f}]')
print('More negative = more anomalous')

# Visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))

plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)
plt.scatter(normal[:, 0], normal[:, 1], c='blue', s=20, label='Normal')
plt.scatter(anomalies[:, 0], anomalies[:, 1], c='red', s=100, label='Anomaly', marker='x')
plt.legend()
plt.title('LOF Detection')

plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)
plt.scatter(X[:, 0], X[:, 1], c=scores, cmap='coolwarm', s=30)
plt.colorbar(label='LOF Score')
plt.title('LOF Scores (more negative = more anomalous)')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print('\nLOF: Local density vs neighbors. Low density area = anomaly.')
codeExamples.explanation: LOF: Local density-based. Cluster içinde normal, cluster dışında/arası anomaly. k-NN based, density comparison.

codeExamples.title: One-Class SVM
codeExamples.code:
import numpy as np
from sklearn.svm import OneClassSVM
from sklearn.datasets import make_blobs
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Normal data (training)
X_train, _ = make_blobs(n_samples=300, centers=1, cluster_std=0.5, random_state=42)

# Test data (normal + outliers)
X_test_normal, _ = make_blobs(n_samples=100, centers=1, cluster_std=0.5, random_state=99)
X_test_outliers = np.random.uniform(low=-4, high=4, size=(20, 2))
X_test = np.vstack([X_test_normal, X_test_outliers])
y_test_true = np.array([1]*100 + [-1]*20)  # 1=normal, -1=anomaly

print(f'Train: {len(X_train)}, Test: {len(X_test)} (100 normal, 20 outliers)')

# One-Class SVM
clf = OneClassSVM(
    kernel='rbf',
    gamma='auto',
    nu=0.05  # Upper bound on fraction of outliers
)

clf.fit(X_train)
y_pred = clf.predict(X_test)

# Evaluation
from sklearn.metrics import classification_report, confusion_matrix
print('\nClassification Report:')
print(classification_report(y_test_true, y_pred, target_names=['Anomaly', 'Normal']))

print('\nConfusion Matrix:')
print(confusion_matrix(y_test_true, y_pred))

# Decision boundary
xx, yy = np.meshgrid(np.linspace(-4, 4, 100), np.linspace(-4, 4, 100))
Z = clf.decision_function(np.c_[xx.ravel(), yy.ravel()])
Z = Z.reshape(xx.shape)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))

plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)
plt.contourf(xx, yy, Z, levels=np.linspace(Z.min(), 0, 7), cmap='Blues_r', alpha=0.6)
plt.contour(xx, yy, Z, levels=[0], linewidths=2, colors='red')
plt.scatter(X_train[:, 0], X_train[:, 1], c='blue', s=10, label='Train (normal)', alpha=0.5)
plt.legend()
plt.title('One-Class SVM Decision Boundary')

plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)
plt.scatter(X_test[y_pred == 1][:, 0], X_test[y_pred == 1][:, 1], c='blue', s=20, label='Normal')
plt.scatter(X_test[y_pred == -1][:, 0], X_test[y_pred == -1][:, 1], c='red', s=50, label='Anomaly', marker='x')
plt.legend()
plt.title('Test Predictions')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
codeExamples.explanation: One-Class SVM: Normal data boundary öğren. Kernel trick (RBF), non-linear boundary. nu parameter: outlier fraction upper bound.

codeExamples.title: Autoencoder Anomaly Detection
codeExamples.code:
import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from sklearn.datasets import make_blobs
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Data
X_train, _ = make_blobs(n_samples=500, centers=1, cluster_std=0.5, random_state=42)
X_test_normal, _ = make_blobs(n_samples=100, centers=1, cluster_std=0.5, random_state=99)
X_test_outliers = np.random.uniform(low=-4, high=4, size=(20, 2))
X_test = np.vstack([X_test_normal, X_test_outliers])

X_train_tensor = torch.FloatTensor(X_train)
X_test_tensor = torch.FloatTensor(X_test)

print(f'Train: {len(X_train)}, Test: {len(X_test)}')

# Autoencoder
class Autoencoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim=2, encoding_dim=1):
        super().__init__()
        self.encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, 4),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(4, encoding_dim)
        )
        self.decoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(encoding_dim, 4),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(4, input_dim)
        )
    
    def forward(self, x):
        encoded = self.encoder(x)
        decoded = self.decoder(encoded)
        return decoded

model = Autoencoder()
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.01)
criterion = nn.MSELoss()

# Train
print('\nTraining autoencoder...')
for epoch in range(100):
    model.train()
    optimizer.zero_grad()
    reconstructed = model(X_train_tensor)
    loss = criterion(reconstructed, X_train_tensor)
    loss.backward()
    optimizer.step()
    
    if (epoch + 1) % 20 == 0:
        print(f'Epoch {epoch+1}, Loss: {loss.item():.4f}')

# Test: Reconstruction error
model.eval()
with torch.no_grad():
    reconstructed = model(X_test_tensor)
    errors = torch.mean((X_test_tensor - reconstructed) ** 2, dim=1).numpy()

# Threshold: 95th percentile
threshold = np.percentile(errors, 95)
y_pred = (errors > threshold).astype(int)

print(f'\nReconstruction error range: [{errors.min():.4f}, {errors.max():.4f}]')
print(f'Threshold (95th percentile): {threshold:.4f}')
print(f'Detected: {y_pred.sum()} anomalies')

# Visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 4))

plt.subplot(1, 3, 1)
plt.scatter(X_test[:, 0], X_test[:, 1], c=errors, cmap='coolwarm', s=30)
plt.colorbar(label='Reconstruction Error')
plt.title('Reconstruction Errors')

plt.subplot(1, 3, 2)
plt.hist(errors, bins=30, alpha=0.7)
plt.axvline(threshold, color='r', linestyle='--', label='Threshold')
plt.legend()
plt.title('Error Distribution')

plt.subplot(1, 3, 3)
plt.scatter(X_test[y_pred==0][:, 0], X_test[y_pred==0][:, 1], c='blue', s=20, label='Normal')
plt.scatter(X_test[y_pred==1][:, 0], X_test[y_pred==1][:, 1], c='red', s=50, label='Anomaly', marker='x')
plt.legend()
plt.title('Detected Anomalies')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
codeExamples.explanation: Autoencoder: Normal data'yı reconstruct et. Anomaly → high reconstruction error. Deep learning, complex patterns, images/time series için güçlü.

codeExamples.title: Time Series Anomaly (LSTM Autoencoder)
codeExamples.code:
import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Generate time series
np.random.seed(42)
t = np.linspace(0, 100, 1000)
normal_series = np.sin(t/5) + 0.1*np.random.randn(1000)

# Inject anomalies
anomalies_idx = [200, 201, 202, 600, 601]
for idx in anomalies_idx:
    normal_series[idx] += 3  # Spike

data = normal_series

# Create sequences
def create_sequences(data, seq_length=50):
    sequences = []
    for i in range(len(data) - seq_length):
        sequences.append(data[i:i+seq_length])
    return np.array(sequences)

seq_length = 50
sequences = create_sequences(data, seq_length)
X = torch.FloatTensor(sequences).unsqueeze(-1)  # (N, seq_len, 1)

print(f'Sequences: {X.shape}')

# LSTM Autoencoder
class LSTMAutoencoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim=1, hidden_dim=32, num_layers=1):
        super().__init__()
        self.encoder = nn.LSTM(input_dim, hidden_dim, num_layers, batch_first=True)
        self.decoder = nn.LSTM(hidden_dim, input_dim, num_layers, batch_first=True)
    
    def forward(self, x):
        encoded, _ = self.encoder(x)
        decoded, _ = self.decoder(encoded)
        return decoded

model = LSTMAutoencoder()
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)
criterion = nn.MSELoss()

# Train
print('\nTraining LSTM Autoencoder...')
for epoch in range(50):
    model.train()
    optimizer.zero_grad()
    reconstructed = model(X)
    loss = criterion(reconstructed, X)
    loss.backward()
    optimizer.step()
    
    if (epoch + 1) % 10 == 0:
        print(f'Epoch {epoch+1}, Loss: {loss.item():.4f}')

# Detect anomalies
model.eval()
with torch.no_grad():
    reconstructed = model(X)
    errors = torch.mean((X - reconstructed) ** 2, dim=(1, 2)).numpy()

threshold = np.percentile(errors, 95)
anomalies_detected = errors > threshold

print(f'\nDetected anomalies: {anomalies_detected.sum()}')

# Visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 8))

plt.subplot(3, 1, 1)
plt.plot(data, label='Original')
plt.scatter(anomalies_idx, data[anomalies_idx], c='red', s=100, marker='x', label='True Anomalies')
plt.legend()
plt.title('Time Series with Anomalies')

plt.subplot(3, 1, 2)
plt.plot(errors, label='Reconstruction Error')
plt.axhline(threshold, color='r', linestyle='--', label='Threshold')
plt.legend()
plt.title('Reconstruction Errors')

plt.subplot(3, 1, 3)
plt.plot(data[seq_length:], alpha=0.5, label='Data')
detected_idx = np.where(anomalies_detected)[0] + seq_length
plt.scatter(detected_idx, data[detected_idx], c='red', s=50, marker='x', label='Detected Anomalies')
plt.legend()
plt.title('Detected Anomalies')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
codeExamples.explanation: LSTM Autoencoder: Time series anomaly. Temporal dependencies öğrenir. Reconstruction error → anomaly. Predictive maintenance, sensor monitoring için.

quiz.question: Anomaly detection'ın temel prensibi nedir?
options: Normal pattern'den önemli ölçüde sapan rare instance'ları tespit et
quiz.explanation: Anomaly detection: Normal'den önemli sapma. Rare, unexpected patterns. Unsupervised (çoğunlukla), imbalanced (%0.1-5 anomaly).

quiz.question: Isolation Forest nasıl çalışır?
options: Anomaly'leri izole etmek kolay (az tree split), ensemble of trees
quiz.explanation: Isolation Forest: Anomaly'leri izole etmek kolay (az split yeterli). Random tree ensemble, avg path length. Scalable, no distribution assumption.

quiz.question: LOF (Local Outlier Factor) neyi ölçer?
options: Local density vs neighbors. Düşük local density = anomaly
quiz.explanation: LOF: Local density-based. Komşularla density karşılaştır. Cluster içinde normal, dışında/arası anomaly. K-NN based.

quiz.question: Autoencoder anomaly detection prensibi?
options: Normal data'yı reconstruct et, anomaly → yüksek reconstruction error
quiz.explanation: Autoencoder: Normal data ile train et, reconstruct öğren. Anomaly'yi reconstruct edemez → high error. Deep learning, complex patterns için.

quiz.question: Anomaly detection'da contamination parameter nedir?
quiz.explanation: Contamination: Training data'daki expected anomaly ratio. Örn: 0.01 = %1 anomaly var. Threshold belirlemeye yardımcı. Isolation Forest, LOF'ta kullanılır.

quiz.question: Time series anomaly için en uygun yöntem?
options: LSTM Autoencoder - temporal dependencies öğrenir, reconstruction error
quiz.explanation: Time series: LSTM Autoencoder ideal (temporal patterns). Alternatif: STL decomposition, ARIMA residuals, Prophet. Contextual anomaly (seasonal).

quiz.question: Anomaly detection evaluation metrikleri?
options: Precision, Recall, F1 (imbalanced), ROC-AUC, Confusion Matrix
quiz.explanation: Imbalanced problem: Precision (false positive), Recall (false negative), F1, ROC-AUC. Confusion matrix: FP vs FN trade-off analizi.

quiz.question: Production anomaly detection challenge?
options: Real-time scoring, threshold tuning (FP vs FN), concept drift, streaming data
quiz.explanation: Production: (1) Real-time (streaming), (2) Threshold (dynamic, adaptive), (3) Concept drift (retrain), (4) Alert system, (5) Explainability (hangi feature?), (6) Feedback loop.

Local density vs neighbors. Düşük local density = anomaly. Cluster içinde normal, dışında/arası anomaly. K-NN based.
Normal data boundary öğren. Kernel trick (RBF), non-linear boundary. nu parameter: outlier fraction upper bound.
Normal data reconstruct et. Anomaly → high reconstruction error. Deep learning, complex patterns, images/time series için.
|z| = |(x-μ)/σ| > 3 → anomaly. Gaussian assumption. Univariate, hızlı, baseline. Multivariate: Mahalanobis distance.
Expected anomaly ratio (örn: 0.01 = %1). Threshold belirlemeye yardımcı. Isolation Forest, LOF'ta kullanılır.
LSTM Autoencoder (temporal dependencies), STL decomposition, ARIMA residuals, Prophet. Contextual anomaly (seasonal).
Point (single), Contextual (time/location dependent), Collective (sequence). Supervised, semi-supervised, unsupervised.
Percentile-based (95th), ROC curve (if labels), domain expert (acceptable FP rate). Dynamic/adaptive (production).
Hangi feature anomaly'yi tetikledi? SHAP, feature contribution, attention weights. Actionable insight.
Real-time scoring, threshold adaptation, concept drift detection, alert system, feedback loop (manual labels → retrain).

commonMistakes.mistake: Tüm outlier'ları anomaly olarak kabul etmek
commonMistakes.why: Outlier ≠ her zaman anomaly. Domain context önemli. Bazı outlier'lar valid (rare but normal). Bazı in-distribution'lar anomaly (fraud mimicking normal).
commonMistakes.fix: Domain expert ile validate et. Contextual anomaly (seasonal, location). Semi-supervised: Az label varsa kullan. Explainability: Neden anomaly?

commonMistakes.why: Anomaly %0.1-5 → extreme imbalance. Accuracy misleading (%99 normal → always predict normal = %99 accuracy!). Model bias towards majority.
commonMistakes.fix: Doğru metrikler: Precision, Recall, F1, ROC-AUC. Confusion matrix analizi (FP vs FN). Cost-sensitive learning (FN costly). SMOTE for anomalies (synthetic).

commonMistakes.why: Data distribution zamanla değişir (concept drift). Static threshold → false positive/negative artar. Seasonal patterns (summer vs winter).
commonMistakes.fix: Dynamic threshold: Percentile-based (sliding window), adaptive (feedback loop). Time-dependent threshold. Domain rules (business hours vs night).

commonMistakes.why: Training'de anomaly var (unlabeled) → model anomaly'yi normal öğrenir. Performance düşer, false negatives artar.
commonMistakes.fix: Data cleaning: Training'den suspected anomalies'i çıkar (bootstrapping). Contamination parameter set et (expected ratio). Robust methods: Isolation Forest (handles some contamination).

commonMistakes.why: Raw features yetersiz olabilir. Domain knowledge ile feature engineering → performance %50+ artabilir. Time series: Lag features, seasonality.
commonMistakes.fix: Domain features: Time series (lag, rolling stats), transactions (frequency, amount deviation), network (packet rate, unusual ports). Feature selection: İlgisiz features noise.

commonMistakes.why: Anomaly detected ama neden? Actionable değil. Manual review zorlaşır. False positive'leri anlamak zor.
commonMistakes.fix: Explainability: SHAP (feature contribution), attention weights (autoencoder), feature deviation (which feature anomalous?). Alert'e explanation ekle.

commonMistakes.why: Manual review sonuçları modele dönmez. Model improve edemez. Same false positives tekrar eder.
commonMistakes.fix: Feedback loop: Manual labels (TP, FP, FN) → periodic retrain. Active learning (uncertain samples → label). Threshold tuning (FP rate acceptable mı?).
